trigger.reason_for_stop: The regenerated Parquet did not reproduce the original byte-level SHA-256.
trigger.outcome_boundary: No drought parent-block aggregation, block correlation, permutation distribution, p-value, or multiscale result had been computed or inspected when this amendment was frozen.

diagnostic_observation_allowed_before_am.purpose: Determine whether the mismatch was clearly substantive or could be serialization or machine-precision drift.
diagnostic_observation_allowed_before_am.four_corners_ecs_summary_comparison: Count and mean matched exactly; standard deviation, quartiles, and extrema matched the committed audit within 1.2e-16.
diagnostic_observation_allowed_before_am.interpretation: This is necessary but not sufficient validation. It does not authorize analysis by itself.

replacement_input_rule.original_rule: Require the original publication-join binary SHA-256.
replacement_input_rule.amended_rule: For each missing drought publication join only, accept a newly regenerated join if and only if every validation gate below passes against the committed baseline. Existing lava and forest-loss artifacts still require exact original SHA-256 matches.
replacement_input_rule.uniform_application: The same gates and tolerances apply to all three drought events. No gate may be changed after any drought block outcome is computed.
replacement_input_rule.failure_policy: If any gate fails, stop the complete eight-case analysis. Do not omit, replace, or selectively relax an event.

required_regeneration.alphaearth: Use the unchanged annual embedding mosaics, pre/post years, ECS formula, H3 cells, 10 m scale, tileScale 4, and mean+max+stdDev+p95 reducer from disaster_embedding_pipeline.py. Client-side checkpointing or request sharding may alter transport only, not the estimand.
required_regeneration.official_usdm: Use the exact archived NDMC annual vector ZIP files and AOI files whose SHA-256 values are recorded in the committed usdm_official_validation.json.
required_regeneration.publication_join: Use joined_official.parquet produced by usdm_official_h3.py. The Earth Engine USDM mirror remains an implementation cross-check, not the publication reference.

structural_exact: event key, pre year, post year, season, score mapping, and weekly release-date lists
H3 row count, unique H3 set, and H3 resolution
required columns and finite ECS and official-reference values
official_reference_complete and the event-specific mirror agreement status, including the previously recorded Iowa mirror disagreement

recursive_audit_comparison.floating_values: absolute difference at most 1e-10 and relative difference at most 1e-10
recursive_audit_comparison.reason_for_exclusions: These are byte-level hashes of regenerated Parquet files and are expected to change with serialization or machine-level reduction differences.

required_contents: old recorded and newly observed artifact SHA-256 values
every structural, source-hash, and recursive-comparison result
maximum absolute and relative numeric discrepancy by event and baseline file
overall pass=false if any individual check fails

interpretation_effect.additional_limitation: The drought joins are reproducible reconstructions validated against committed audits, not byte-identical recovery of the missing original Parquet files.
